name: seo-audit
description: Full-site SEO audit orchestrator. Crawls the site, detects business type, fans out to the seo-* specialist skills, then aggregates an evidence-backed 0-100 health score and a prioritized action plan (Critical → Low). Use when user says "audit", "full SEO check", "analyze my site", "website health check", or "SEO report". Triggers on: seo audit, full seo check, site health score, action plan, crawl my site, technical+content+schema audit.
